categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: Carries the Scripts and tools label and modifies contrib/verify-binaries/verify.py and its test suite.
categories.rationale: Fixes a security-relevant correctness bug in binary verification where untrusted signatures were counted toward --min-good-sigs. Previously, verify_shasums_signature added len(good_untrusted) to num_trusted, allowing valid signatures from untrusted keys in the user's keyring to satisfy verification thresholds even when trusted keys did not match.
